pdf.js 4.10.38 (pdfjs-dist, legacy build) from npm, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE).
Used only by js/views/book.js to read the text of a PDF the learner picks; loaded on demand.
standard_fonts/: the 14 standard PDF fonts from the same package (see LICENSE_FOXIT and LICENSE_LIBERATION there),
so a PDF that does not carry its own fonts still shows its text in the page view.
